title: Choose a row or column selection representation
brief: Select by the representation you have: mask, indices, contiguous range, or column positions. Nullable indices, non-nullable fields and zero-column batches change the valid composition.

choices.choose_when: Keep true mask positions in source order
choices.tradeoff: False and null mask positions are excluded.

choices.choose_when: Gather in requested order, including repeated indices
choices.tradeoff: Array take and multi-array take_arrays expose checked bounds; the batch helper does not expose options.
Slice may retain shared source allocations; projection does not select rows.

choices.choose_when: Selection belongs within an optimizable relation
choices.tradeoff: Avoid hiding pushdown opportunities by selecting only after collection.

claims.statement: filter_record_batch takes a batch and BooleanArray and returns Result<RecordBatch>. Array take takes values, integer indices and optional TakeOptions and returns Result<ArrayRef>. Mask length must fit the source selection domain.
Filter keeps source order and excludes false/null mask entries. Take preserves index order and multiplicity; null indices introduce null values.
TakeOptions.check_bounds=true requests checked errors. With unchecked indices, out-of-bounds access can panic despite Result. take_record_batch calls array take with None in this pin.

Gathering null indices may violate a non-nullable output field. RecordBatch construction checks top-level nullability. Choose compatible output fields; an array result alone does not carry schema metadata.

A zero-column batch can have rows via RecordBatchOptions.row_count. filter_record_batch retains the selected count; take_record_batch in 59.3.0 reconstructs with try_new and errors. For zero columns, validate non-null indices against input row count and build the output with explicit indices.len() row count.
Slices and some selection paths share buffers. Logical output size does not bound retained allocation size.

implementation: Choose mask/index/range/column semantics before the API.
Check indices and output nullability, preserving field/schema metadata deliberately.
For zero columns, use explicit row-count construction and retain the same index-domain validation.
Use take_arrays for a shared gather across columns before constructing a batch with the desired output fields/options.
unknowns: Tests cover Int32/UInt32 and tested metadata; nested/view layouts and every datatype are not qualified.

evidence.scope: Pinned hosted rustdoc; availability depends on the consumer profile.
Only the named assertions in the recorded Cargo profile.
Selected exact published source; source-manifest.json retains provenance.

invalidation.reason: Review changed signatures, docs, availability, and newly viable alternatives.
